_doc: Render-count budgets for issue #298 AC1-3 (re-render reduction). Captured against the live dev build and locked as upper bounds. Values are StrictMode-doubled per src/hooks/dev/useRenderCount.ts (StrictMode is on in src/main.tsx). Headroom: +2 for App (more async fan-out), +1 for other components. Tighten only with a code change that reduces renders. Loosening (raising a number) is a regression and must come with an explicit reason in the commit body.
